correctness.rationale: The original Lindblad generator closes exactly on the four-site covariance, whose homogeneous Hermitian stationary system is coercive at both endpoint rows and propagates zero along the connected chain. The 16-by-16 stationary determinant factors into positive terms. The exact current and tridiagonal gap follow by rational elimination; the latter has a strict positive numerator for nonzero tilt. The full dephasing derivative polynomial has negative high-degree coefficients and four ordered unique positive parameter thresholds among its low-degree coefficients, giving exactly one sign change (or no positive sign) and hence complete monotone/unimodal classification. An independent 16-state Fock-space Lindblad solver corroborates five samples; symbolic checks independently reconstruct all polynomial identities.

value.rationale: The first size at which longer-range coherences are discarded admits a uniform strictly one-sided approximation error: this quantifies the systematic failure of the main large-chain approximation. The sharp exact squared-tilt transition distinguishes a global absence of noise-assisted current enhancement from a unique positive optimal rate, rather than supplying a single numerical parameter case. This is a motivated finite-transport benchmark, not an arbitrary graph invariant.
